shortDescription: East Japan Railway Co. warned that the approaching tropical cyclone Dujuan could suspend or delay train lines in the greater Tokyo area from as early as Sunday evening through Tuesday morning, according to Bloomberg.The operator said disruptions are possible on its services as the storm nears Japan.

title: GEOPOLITICS | Tropical Storm Dujuan May Disrupt Tokyo-Area Trains
